name: CanvasTTY Accounts
description: Any agent on any model: run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen Code or Kimi on a local Ollama model, Ollama Cloud, Z.AI, MiniMax, OpenRouter or any compatible API, chosen per launch as a Model account, with reasoning effort per launch. Orchestrators list and pick accounts for subagents. The agents' own sign-ins and ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.ollama stay untouched.
description.ru: Любой агент на любой модели: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen Code или Kimi на локальной модели Ollama, в Ollama Cloud, Z.AI, MiniMax, OpenRouter или любом совместимом API — учётная запись модели выбирается при запуске, как и глубина рассуждений. Оркестраторы видят и выбирают учётные записи для субагентов. Собственные входы агентов и ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.ollama не меняются.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Accounts
services.description: Prepares launches on a chosen model account and answers orchestrators' route questions.

fields.label: I trust this folder (skip the agent's folder question for this account)

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List the person's model accounts you can start a subagent on: agent (provider), account, model, where it runs, and whether it is ready now (key saved, Ollama running, model installed with tool calling) or why not. A ready route has launchOptions: pass them unchanged to spawn_agent with the same provider. Each agent's own CLI sign-in is not listed: spawn_agent without launchOptions uses it.

provider.description: Only this agent: claude, codex, opencode, qwen or kimi.

model.description: Only accounts whose model name contains this text.

effort.description: Reasoning effort to put into launchOptions: default, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max (as the agent supports).

tools.name: pick_account
tools.description: Pick the model account a subagent of this agent should run on: the first ready one in the person's order, skipping accounts that cannot work right now (no key, Ollama not running, model missing), with the reason. Returns spawn: { provider, launchOptions } to pass to spawn_agent. An error means no account is ready: spawn without launchOptions to use the agent's own sign-in, or ask the person.

provider.description: The agent: claude, codex, opencode, qwen or kimi.

model.description: Prefer accounts whose model name contains this text.

effort.description: Reasoning effort: default, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max (as the agent supports).
